messages.subject: Stratton MSA – Denham Lewis comments and our proposed response
messages.plaintextBody:
Sofia, Daniel,

Stratton's mark-up (their version 2) is in. The substantive asks are a higher liability cap (200%), 99.9% uptime, UK-only hosting, 60-day payment terms and a right to terminate for convenience. None is unusual for a customer of their size.

Subject to your instructions we propose to respond with: a 150% cap (carve-outs uncapped), 99.8% uptime, UK hosting with EEA sub-processors permitted, 45-day payment terms, and termination for convenience only after the initial term on 180 days' notice. Maya – the 45-day terms have a small working-capital impact worth noting.

Let me know if you're happy and we'll send our revised draft ahead of the call on 12 May.

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
